{{Short description|French biologist (1946–2021)}}
'''Michel Caboche''' (25 April 1946 - 15 March 2021)<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.inrae.fr/actualites/michel-caboche-pionnier-biologie-vegetale |title=Michel Caboche, pionnier en biologie végétale |date=19 March 2021 |website=INRAE |publisher=Institut national de recherche pour l'agriculture, l'alimentation et l'environnement |language=French |access-date=1 August 2021}}</ref>
, was a French [[biologist]], director of research at [[Institut national de la recherche agronomique]] (INRA), member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] and of the Scientific Council of the Parliamentary Office for the Assessment of Scientific and Technological Choices (OPECST).

He was deputy director of the INRA-(INA-PG) Seed Biology Laboratory in [[Versailles, Yvelines|Versailles]], and headed the INRA-[[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]]-University of Evry Joint Unit for Plant Genomics Research from 2002 to 2007. He was chairman of the board of the French plant genomics program, Génoplante, from its 1999 inception to 2002. He was a member of the steering committee of the Fondation Écologie d'Avenir.<ref name="renamed_from_2_on_20191120140311">{{Cite web|url=http://fondationecologiedavenir.org/Conseil_Orientation.htm|title=Fondationecologiedavenir.org|website=fondationecologiedavenir.org|access-date=2019-11-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140527142717/http://fondationecologiedavenir.org/Conseil_Orientation.htm|archive-date=2014-05-27|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Caboche graduated from the [[École Polytechnique|École polytechnique]] and held a doctorate in science.<ref>{{cite web|title=CV Michel Caboche|url=http://www.academie-sciences.fr/pdf/membre/CabocheM_bio0411.pdf|website=www.academie-sciences.fr}}</ref>

== Works ==
Caboche's research focused on plant biology, in particular [[nitrate]] metabolism, growth processes and seed filling.

== Awards and honours ==

*   Philip Morris Science Prize (1990)
*   Member of the French Academy of sciences (correspondent in 1993 and member in 2004)<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-C/michel-caboche.html|website=www.academie-sciences.fr}}</ref>
*   Member of [[Academia Europaea]] (1991)<ref>{{cite web|title=Academia europaea 2|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Caboche_Michel|website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>
*   Member of [[European Molecular Biology Organization|EMBO]] (1995)
*   Max Planck Society and Alexander von Humboldt Foundation Prize for International Cooperation (1996)
*   Associate Member of the [[Royal Academies for Science and the Arts of Belgium|Royal Academy of Belgium]] (1999)
*   Chevalier of the [[Ordre national du Mérite]] (2004)
*   Chevalier of the [[Legion of Honour|Ordre national de la Légion d'honneur]] (2010)
